question: Do any co-split triples in the fixed panel have an even sum of native trace vectors, permitting the zero residual trace R=0 and a degree-two relation intersection?
rule: For every triple of distinct native covers, test wi+wj+wk in2M. This criterion is independent of branch signs. If it holds, S=(wi+wj+wk)/2 is a rational generic section. On the certified disjoint-branch geometry the translated pair-image intersection has degree h(2S-w)+2=2. Check all eight branch sums at the existing parameter, without computing any new intersection parameter.
selection: All co-split triples at all165 fixed published-R17 addresses. Use no gain labels, exceptional coordinates, or ranked subset of triples.
failure_semantics: Trace parity alone is an incidence condition for a low-degree relation scheme, not proof that its quadratic algebra splits. If no triple qualifies, report that fact; do not invent a global-solubility obstruction for other triples. Geometric degree-two claims require the same image-class hypotheses as the prior triple-intersection proof.
